+# Game status categories
+# Change the values as you see fit
+STATUS_WIN = 'win'
+STATUS_LOSE = 'lose'
+STATUS_ONGOING = 'ongoing'
+
+
+class Hangman:
+    def __init__(self, word: str):
+        self.word = word
+        self.remaining_guesses = 9
+        self.status = STATUS_ONGOING
+        self.guessed_chars = set()
+
+    def guess(self, char: str) -> None:
+        # Check if game has already ended
+        if self.status != STATUS_ONGOING:
+            raise ValueError("The game has already ended.")
+        
+        # Process the guess
+        if char in self.word and char not in self.guessed_chars:
+            # Correct guess
+            self.guessed_chars.add(char)
+        else:
+            # Incorrect guess
+            self.remaining_guesses -= 1
+        
+        # Update game status
+        self._update_status()
+
+    def _update_status(self) -> None:
+        # Check for win: all characters in word have been guessed
+        if all(char in self.guessed_chars for char in self.word):
+            self.status = STATUS_WIN
+        # Check for loss: no more guesses remaining
+        elif self.remaining_guesses < 0:
+            self.status = STATUS_LOSE
+        # Otherwise, game is ongoing
+        else:
+            self.status = STATUS_ONGOING
+
+    def get_masked_word(self) -> str:
+        # Return the word with unguessed characters masked
+        return ''.join(char if char in self.guessed_chars else '_' for char in self.word)
+
+    def get_status(self) -> str:
+        return self.status
